location_exception_reason: Portable toilet cabins are manufactured products with standardised specifications (FRP/PVC construction, seat type, tank capacity, dimensions). Location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision-making; buyers select based on material, seat type, and cabin configuration, not origin geography. No GI protection or regional origin claim applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title like 'Sintex Portable Toilet Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product description; the product meaning is unchanged.
